verdict.rationale: First-party marketing shows a Sales Cloud dashboard view and promises complete pipeline visibility, real-time insights, and advanced forecast and pipeline management. That points to built-in, in-product reporting rather than spreadsheet exports. However, nothing explicitly documents a self-serve report or dashboard builder, or reporting on activity or conversion metrics. Missing for 10: documented custom report/dashboard builder, explicit activity and conversion reporting, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
